instruction_sequence.comparison: same opcode count, calls, predicates and control-flow contract; branch block placement differs

branch_contract.odd_bit_gate: calls tp_ghost_check and enters the ghost branch only when bit 0 is set
branch_contract.counter_limit: reads cdev + 0x4a8 and takes the limit path when the count is greater than 2
branch_contract.callback_path: loads cdev + 0xff0, applies the KCFI guard, invokes callback(cdev), logs and increments

relocation_normalization.reason: The separately linked module places local strings at different .rodata offsets and the compiler lays out the limit block after the callback block; resolved strings, call targets, predicates, offsets and common-tail behavior match.

limitations: Raw ELF relocation and instruction-byte identity is not exact across independently linked modules.
The host harness stubs tp_ghost_check, ghost_check_reset, printk and the valid callback.
The invalid KCFI path is statically inspected and intentionally not invoked by the host harness.
No smartphone, scheduler or physical hardware was used.
